name: Plascar Participacoes Industriais S.A.
summary: Plascar Participações Industriais S.A., through its subsidiary, manufactures and sells interior and exterior finishing auto parts in Brazil. The company's products include bumpers, dashboards, air diffusers, cup holders, door trim panels, parcel racks, package trays, lighting equipment, and other components. Plascar Participações Industriais S.A. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Jundiaí, Brazil. Plascar Participações Industriais S.A. is a subsidiary of Padua IV Participações S.A.
